page.overview:
Who is Clive Reston?

Clive Reston is an enemy of Fu Manchu who fought a long war against him alongside Shang-Chi.

Clive Reston was a smooth talker and had some "very interesting relatives". He joined Shang-Chi, Sir Denis Nayland Smith, Petrie and Black Jack Tarr in the war against Fu Manchu.
